title: Reuse hasLegacyIntegrations() for legacy (v0) integration checks in contact points
answers: How do I check if a contact point has a legacy/v0 integration?
Why is Export disabled for this contact point?
Export is not available for contact points that contain legacy integrations
How to detect deprecated notifier versions in the UI?
body:
Symptom: a contact point containing a legacy (v0) integration could still be exported/handled as if fully supported, or conversely a current-version integration whose version string happens to look like a legacy id (e.g. 'v0mimir1') got wrongly flagged as legacy.
Root cause: reviewers flagged that re-implementing the legacy check locally (e.g. string-matching on the config's `version` field) drifts from the canonical logic, which must compare against the notifier's actual `currentVersion` metadata, not a naive `startsWith('v0')` heuristic.
Fix pattern: always call `hasLegacyIntegrations(contactPoint, notifiers)` from public/app/features/alerting/unified/utils/notifier-versions.ts, fetching `notifiers` via `useIntegrationTypeSchemas()` (public/app/features/alerting/unified/api/integrationSchemasApi.ts), instead of writing a new ad-hoc check.
Constraints: applies to any UI surface that needs to know whether a contact point's integrations are legacy/v0 (export gating, warnings, migration UI); does not apply to backend provisioning logic which has its own equivalent check.
applies: Grafana Alerting contact point UI, anywhere legacy (v0) integration status must be determined client-side
